label: Video Conferencing
description: Zoom-like video meetings with WebRTC, screen sharing, recording, and chat — with built-in Stripe-backed subscription tiers

MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Mailgun API key for meeting invites

TURN_SERVER_URL.description: TURN server URL for WebRTC relay (consumed by the browser at call time; live-call tests are BLOCKED: TURN_SERVER_URL required when not set)

TURN_SERVER_SECRET.description: TURN server shared secret (consumed only when minting per-peer credentials; live-call tests are BLOCKED: TURN_SERVER_SECRET required when not set)

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_test_... in test mode)

STRIPE_VIDEO_CONFERENCING_PRO_MONTHLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro Monthly plan

STRIPE_VIDEO_CONFERENCING_PRO_YEARLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro Yearly plan

STRIPE_VIDEO_CONFERENCING_TEAM_MONTHLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Team Monthly plan

STRIPE_VIDEO_CONFERENCING_TEAM_YEARLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Team Yearly plan
